result:
I made the excerpt optional and auto-derived it from the body:

- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: `excerpt` is now `.optional()` (no `min(1)`), so a missing/blank/whitespace-only value passes validation.
- **`app/Support/excerpt.ts`** (new): `deriveExcerptFromBody(body)` implements the 140-char, no-mid-word-cut, ellipsis rule from the spec.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `store` and `update` now fall back to `deriveExcerptFromBody(data.body)` whenever the submitted excerpt is empty after trimming, otherwise the typed/trimmed excerpt wins — applied fresh on every update so an update that blanks the excerpt re-derives from the new body.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`**: label now reads "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback; inputs handle `undefined` via `?? ''`.
- **`.guren/api-client.gen.ts`**: regenerated (`excerpt?: string` in the `posts.store`/`posts.update` body types).
- Added tests: `tests/excerpt.test.ts` (unit tests for the derivation rule, including both worked examples) and `tests/PostExcerpt.test.ts` (integration tests through `TestApp` for create/update with blank/omitted/provided excerpts and unchanged title/body validation).

`bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (13 pass), and `bun run build` all pass; `bunx guren check` shows only pre-existing warnings unrelated to this change.
